summary: Kingsoft Cloud filed a Form 6-K providing a monthly return to The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong regarding authorized share capital and issued shares for May 2026. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance report with no special situation. No transactions, corporate actions, or strategic changes are disclosed; it merely confirms no movements in issued shares and compliance with public float requirements. As a non-US filing, it serves as the equivalent of a periodic notification. There is no deal to analyze; the filing is purely administrative and does not meet any special-situation category.
